score.title: Plant performance score

score.improveTitle: AI — how to raise the score

tip.productivity: Add a shift/operator on the bottleneck to move output toward target.
tip.delivery: Prioritize late orders on the bottleneck; spot due-date risk early.
tip.quality: Tackle the top scrap reason (setup/dimensional); tighten tooling checks.
tip.utilization: Route work to idle stations; cut setup and waiting losses.
tip.operator: Coach lower-performing operators; spread the best practice.
tip.breakdown: Plan preventive maintenance on frequently failing machines.
tip.capacity: Fill idle capacity with fill-in work; balance the plan.
tip.adherence: Calibrate estimated times to actuals; watch plan deviations.
tip.maintenance: Close overdue tasks; hold the preventive-maintenance rhythm.
